note: Small boat-ramp access on the Grand River east of Bosworth, off Route M on a gravel lane. The primitive camping area is the grassy, tree-dotted ground beside the gravel parking lot, with a privy. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Individual Campsites' - one mapped primitive camping area on the grass beside the gravel lot (the stored pin), free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; privy added. Riverview not supported: the camp is ~80 m from the Grand River behind a 25-35 m wooded band and the bank - suggest not waterfront. Phone matches.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored riverview): suggest DOWNGRADE to not waterfront. Measured on the 0.22 m/px leaf-off frame: GIS camping point 473 (the stored pin) is ~80 m from the Grand River's west edge (the river is ~80 m+ wide). Between them: the rest of the camping grass (~20 m), then a 25-35 m band of bottomland trees that shows as dense trunks even leaf-off (full canopy in summer), then the bare bank slope. The only opening to the water is the boat-ramp lane running NE from the lot, which is a ramp corridor, not the camp. The stored evidence ('open camping grass behind the Grand River bank trees -> riverview') itself places the trees between camp and river. The area page has no photos. No open sightline from the camp itself is visible; unsure resolves down.

INCLUSION/FIT: area page lists 'Individual Campsites' ('This area offers access to the Grand River. There is a boat ramp.'); the 04/13 map shows a Primitive Camping Area symbol beside the parking lot, privy and ramp. GIS point 473 (39.47523,-93.26543) is on the grass ~40 m north of lot 2635 (39.47487,-93.26533; GIS 'Paved', imagery shows a white gravel lot ~40 x 30 m). Reached by a ~200 m gravel lane from Route M (paved) - no ford. A 23-ft rig fits the lot and the grass edge.
